rows.poa_hac_requirements: Requires POA indicators on all inpatient diagnoses; may request records affecting DRG/HAC payment.
Require POA on inpatient diagnoses; POA=N may trigger HAC/never-event denials or DRG reduction.
Requires documented thrombosis/ischemia history; protein C/S also require neonatal purpura fulminans or warfarin necrosis.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy is not DRG-specific, but it affects inpatient DRG reimbursement when a hospital acquired condition is identified and denies major surgical never events and related services. For HACs, charges or days may be removed from the DRG calculation; for never events, the claim and related services are denied.

Commercial inpatient policy: this wrong-body-part never event is denied for professional and facility claims, and related services are not reimbursed. The broader policy also reduces DRG reimbursement for HACs when POA shows the condition was not present on admission.

The DRG is not named, but the policy applies to inpatient urinary infection claims when the urinary condition is a catheter-associated UTI classified as a health care-acquired condition. If it was not present on admission, associated charges/days and any HCAC-linked CC/MCC are excluded from DRG payment calculation, and missing POA data may cause denial or rejection.

state_specific_rules: CA Medicaid: no DVT/PE reporting for pregnant or under 21

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Laboratory - Venous and Arterial Thrombosis Testing
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Reimbursable for thrombophilia testing when linked to specified thrombotic or ischemic conditions.

recommended_action.description: Recommendation 1: Edit Y65.51, Y65.52, and Y65.53 only on the same inpatient claim under DRG review when the condition is not present on admission / POA-based review; for California cesarean or other obstetric claims, do not apply this edit to pediatric and obstetric Medicaid, pregnant women in CA Medicaid, or children under 21 in CA Medicaid, and keep present on admission, secondary facility treatment, Medicare-exempt facilities, and pre-existing at another provider as exemptions. Apply to CA. Exempt: present on admission, secondary facility treatment, Medicare-exempt facilities, pediatric and obstetric Medicaid, pregnant women in CA Medicaid, children under 21 in CA Medicaid, pre-existing at another provider. Peer: Elevance Health internal and external both target Y65.51, Y65.52, and Y65.53 on the same inpatient claim under DRG review and exempt present on admission cases..
